Days after a man was killed by a tiger, the President of the United States posted a video of himself wrestling one. Last Saturday, 23-year-old William Chapman died after entering a tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in England. On Tuesday, Trump reposted real footage of the attack to his 13 million Truth Social followers, with the caption “don’t ever mess with nature.” Then on Wednesday, he posted an AI-generated video of himself wrestling and taming a tiger, set to The Lion Sleeps Tonight. It appears to mimic the original footage. Chapman’s family says this “deeply offensive media content” is causing them “severe distress. South Yorkshire’s mayor condemned the posts. Born Free’s Will Travers said the video trivializes the danger of wild animals. Downing Street said people should respect the family’s wishes but wouldn’t comment on the posts directly.
